qualification.details: B.Tech./ B.E. in Metallurgical & Materials Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering / Aerospace Engineering / Materials Engineering; or M.E./ M.Tech. in Metallurgical & Materials Engineering / Mechanical Engineering or relevant specialization, with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG for GEN/ OBC-NCL/ GEN-EWS and minimum 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST/ PwD. (OR) B.Tech./ B.E. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering / Mechanical Engineering with minimum CGPA 7.5/ 10 or 70% for GEN/ GEN-EWS/ OBC-NCL and minimum CGPA 7.0/ 10 or 65% for SC/ ST/ PwD. (OR) M.Sc. in Physics/ Chemistry/ Materials Science/ Electronics/ Nanoscience and Nanotechnology with M.Tech. in Materials Science/ Metallurgy/ Nanoscience and Nanotechnology/ Ceramic Engineering/ Surface Engineering, with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG for GEN/ GEN-EWS/ OBC-NCL and minimum 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST/ PwD. (OR) M.Sc. in Physics/ Chemistry/ Materials Science/ Polymer/ Electronics/ Nanoscience and Nanotechnology/ Ceramic Engineering/ Surface Engineering and relevant area, with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG (wherever applicable) for GEN/ GEN-EWS/ OBC-NCL and minimum 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST/ PwD. GATE score is not mandatory.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Warangal is 28th September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech./B.E. or M.E./M.Tech. in relevant engineering disciplines, or an M.Sc. with a subsequent M.Tech. in specified fields. Specific percentage criteria apply for different categories.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 33 years for OBC-NCL candidates and 35 years for SC/ST/PwD/Female candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Online or Offline Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is a GATE score mandatory for this application?
faq.answer: No, a GATE score is not mandatory for applying to the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the link provided in the Important Links section or by visiting the official NIT Warangal website before the last date.
